criteria.criterion: US-008 stable Source IDs are equal across equivalent clean clones.
criteria.evidence: identity::tests::source_identity_is_clone_independent_and_content_provenance_is_exact derives equal IDs from equal canonical path and kind.

criteria.criterion: US-009 SHA-256/source/parser provenance is recorded and changes when consumed bytes change.
criteria.evidence: SourceRecord::from_discovered records exact bytes, length, parser contract, discovery provenance, and SHA-256 golden vectors.

criteria.criterion: US-010 duplicate governed identifiers produce collision diagnostics naming all sources.
criteria.evidence: detect_duplicate_governed_identifiers deterministically returns sorted repository-relative locations; coverage verifies reordered input and namespace separation.

criteria.criterion: content edits do not change Source ID solely because content changed.
criteria.evidence: Identity test verifies changed content hashes with an unchanged SourceId.

criteria.criterion: explicit governed Document IDs survive source-path moves; path-only Source IDs do not.
absolute host path, time, random IDs, inode/device data, and Git branch do not affect identity.
criteria.evidence: Identity derivation accepts only canonical path/source kind or explicit identity components; serialization test checks no host-state fields.

criteria.criterion: case-collision and symlink-alias fixtures are deterministic.
criteria.evidence: Discovery case-collision test preserves case-sensitive paths and emits a sorted diagnostic; symlink identity test confirms one discovered semantic source.
